pack.name: RivetCore RMM starter pack
pack.description: Ready-made scripts, check templates and policy drafts so a new RMM install is useful on day one.

scripts.name: Certificate expiry check (Linux)
scripts.description: Shows subject, issuer and days left for a PEM certificate file. Refuses files containing private keys.

params.name: cert_file
params.label: Certificate file
params.description: Absolute path of a PEM or CRT certificate file.

scripts.output: Subject, issuer, expiry date and days left. Exit 0; 2 invalid path or private key file; NOT AVAILABLE without openssl.

scripts.name: Containers (Linux)
scripts.description: Lists Docker and Podman containers and disk usage if installed.
scripts.output: ps -a and system df per engine. Exit 0; NOT AVAILABLE if neither is present.

scripts.name: Scheduled jobs (Linux)
scripts.description: Lists system crontab, cron.d, per-user crontabs and systemd timers.
scripts.output: Non-comment cron lines and the timer list. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Disk usage by filesystem (Linux)
scripts.description: Shows filesystem usage with df, excluding tmpfs, overlay and similar noise.
scripts.output: df -hT table and a list of filesystems at 90 percent or more. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Fail2ban status (Linux)
scripts.description: Shows fail2ban jails and their ban counts if fail2ban is installed.
scripts.output: Jail list and per-jail summary. Exit 0; NOT AVAILABLE if absent.

scripts.name: Failed systemd units (Linux)
scripts.description: Lists failed systemd units and the slowest boot units.
scripts.output: Prints 'FAILED UNITS: N' and details. Exit 0 even when units have failed; NOT AVAILABLE without systemd.

scripts.name: Firewall status (Linux)
scripts.description: Reports the state and rules summary of ufw, firewalld, nftables and iptables, whichever exist.
scripts.output: Per-tool status and a trimmed rule listing. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Inode usage (Linux)
scripts.description: Shows inode usage per filesystem with df -i and flags filesystems at 90 percent or more.
scripts.output: df -i table plus a warning list. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Installed packages (Linux)
scripts.description: Lists installed package names and versions sorted by name.

params.name: limit
params.label: Max packages
params.description: Maximum number of packages to list.

scripts.output: Total count and name-version lines (truncated). Exit 0.

scripts.name: Recent journal errors (Linux)
scripts.description: Shows error-level log entries from the last N hours grouped by unit, with a fallback to syslog files.

params.name: hours
params.label: Hours to look back
params.description: Time window in hours.

params.name: limit
params.label: Max lines
params.description: Maximum number of log lines to show.

scripts.output: Counts by unit then the most recent lines. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Vacuum systemd journal (Linux)
scripts.description: Removes journal entries older than a number of days and reports size before and after.

params.name: keep_days
params.label: Days to keep
params.description: Journal entries older than this are removed.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) only reports the journal size.

scripts.output: [DRY-RUN]/[DONE]/[SKIP] lines with sizes. Exit 0; NOT AVAILABLE without journalctl.

scripts.name: Largest directories under a path (Linux)
scripts.description: Shows the largest first-level directories under a root directory, staying on one filesystem. Aborts after 120 seconds.

params.name: root_dir
params.label: Root directory
params.description: Absolute path whose first-level subdirectories are measured.

params.name: top_n
params.label: Rows to show
params.description: How many directories to list.

scripts.output: Sorted size list. Exit 0; exit 2 on an invalid path or number; notes when the scan timed out.

scripts.name: Recent logins (Linux)
scripts.description: Shows recent logins, failed login count when readable, and users currently logged in.
scripts.output: last, lastb count and who output. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Listening ports (Linux)
scripts.description: Lists listening TCP and UDP sockets with owning processes using ss or netstat.
scripts.output: Socket table. Exit 0; NOT AVAILABLE without ss or netstat.

scripts.name: Logged-in users and sessions (Linux)
scripts.description: Shows active login sessions using loginctl, who and w.
scripts.output: Session listings. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Memory, swap and pressure (Linux)
scripts.description: Reports free memory, swap devices, the top memory consumers and pressure stall information when present.
scripts.output: free output, swap devices, top 5 processes by memory, PSI if present. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Mounts and fstab review (Linux)
scripts.description: Lists mounts, read-only mounts, fstab contents and filesystems at 90 percent or more.
scripts.output: Mount table, flags and warnings. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Reboot and restart needed check (Linux)
scripts.description: Reports whether a reboot is required and which services need a restart (needrestart, Debian flag files, needs-restarting, zypper ps).
scripts.output: Prints 'REBOOT REQUIRED: yes/no' plus details. Always exits 0.

scripts.name: Network diagnostics to a target (Linux)
scripts.description: Pings, traces the route to and resolves a validated host name or IP address.

params.name: target
params.label: Target host
params.description: Host name or IP address to test.

params.name: count
params.label: Ping count
params.description: Number of ping packets.

scripts.output: ping summary, route trace, name resolution. Exit 0; 2 invalid target.

scripts.name: Network interfaces and routes (Linux)
scripts.description: Shows addresses, routes, default gateway and DNS servers.
scripts.output: Interface, route and resolver listing. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Clean package cache (Linux)
scripts.description: Cleans the apt, dnf, yum or zypper package cache and reports bytes before and after.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) only reports the cache size and what would be cleaned.

scripts.output: [DRY-RUN]/[DONE]/[SKIP] lines with sizes. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Privileged accounts audit (Linux)
scripts.description: Lists uid 0 accounts, sudo/wheel/admin members, sudoers entries, NOPASSWD rules, login shells and password-less accounts without printing hashes.
scripts.output: Sections per check. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Reboot if required (Linux)
scripts.description: Schedules a delayed reboot with a wall message only if a reboot is required and none is already scheduled.

params.name: delay_minutes
params.label: Delay minutes
params.description: Minutes until the reboot.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) only reports whether a reboot would be scheduled.

scripts.output: [DRY-RUN]/[DONE]/[SKIP] lines. Exit 0; 3 if scheduling fails.

scripts.name: Restart a systemd unit (Linux)
scripts.description: Restarts a named systemd unit and reports its state before and after. Refuses rivet*, systemd-* and dbus* units.

params.name: unit_name
params.label: Unit name
params.description: Name of the systemd unit to restart, for example nginx.service.

params.name: wait_seconds
params.label: Wait seconds
params.description: How long to wait for the unit to become active.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) only reports what would be restarted.

scripts.output: [DRY-RUN]/[DONE]/[SKIP] lines with is-active before and after. Exit 0; 2 invalid or refused name; 3 unit missing or restart failed.

scripts.name: Security updates available (Linux)
scripts.description: Lists pending security-only updates using apt, dnf, yum or zypper without installing anything.
scripts.output: Count and list of security updates (first 100). Exit 0.

scripts.name: Running services (Linux)
scripts.description: Lists running systemd services and counts enabled unit files.
scripts.output: Running service list and enabled count. Exit 0; NOT AVAILABLE without systemd.

scripts.name: Disk SMART health (Linux)
scripts.description: Runs smartctl health checks on physical disks and NVMe devices.
scripts.output: Per-device health line. Exit 0; NOT AVAILABLE without smartmontools.

scripts.name: SSH server configuration audit (Linux)
scripts.description: Read-only audit of the effective sshd configuration with PASS or REVIEW remarks.
scripts.output: One line per setting with PASS/REVIEW. Exit 0; NOT AVAILABLE if sshd is not installed.

scripts.name: System summary (Linux)
scripts.description: OS release, kernel, architecture, uptime, load, virtualization, CPU and memory, hostname and last boot time.
scripts.output: Prints a labelled summary. Always exits 0.

scripts.name: Time synchronization (Linux)
scripts.description: Reports clock sync state using timedatectl, chrony, ntpq or systemd-timesyncd.
scripts.output: Prints 'SYNCHRONIZED: yes/no/unknown' plus tool output. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Top processes by CPU and memory (Linux)
scripts.description: Lists the busiest processes by CPU and by memory using ps.

params.name: top_n
params.label: Rows to show
params.description: How many processes to list per ranking.

scripts.output: Two tables (by CPU, by memory). Exit 0; NOT AVAILABLE if ps is missing.

scripts.name: Updates available (Linux)
scripts.description: Lists pending package updates using apt, dnf, yum or zypper without refreshing indexes or installing anything.
scripts.output: Package manager name, index age (apt), and a list of upgradable packages (first 100). Exit 0.

scripts.name: Battery health report (Windows)
scripts.description: Reports battery status and charge, and compares design to full-charge capacity as a health percentage.
scripts.output: Battery lines and a Health percentage, or No battery present on desktops. Exit 0.

scripts.name: BitLocker status (Windows)
scripts.description: Reports BitLocker protection status, encryption percentage and key protector types for each volume. Never prints recovery passwords or keys.
scripts.output: Table of volumes with status and protector types. Exit 0; prints NOT AVAILABLE if BitLocker cmdlets are missing.

scripts.name: Clean Chrome and Edge cache (Windows)
scripts.description: Clears the Cache, Code Cache and GPUCache folders of Chrome and Edge for all user profiles, skipping a running browser. Cookies, history and passwords are not touched. Dry run by default.

params.name: browser
params.label: Browser
params.description: Which browser caches to clear.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) nothing is changed and the script only reports what it would do.

scripts.output: Per-folder [DONE]/[DRY-RUN]/[SKIP] lines and total bytes. Exit 0; exit 2 on invalid parameters.

scripts.name: Expiring certificates (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists certificates in a LocalMachine store that are expired or expire within a number of days.

params.name: days
params.label: Days ahead
params.description: Report certificates expiring within this many days (expired ones are always included).

params.name: store
params.label: Certificate store
params.description: LocalMachine store to inspect.

scripts.output: Count and table of expired or expiring certificates (status, days left, subject, thumbprint). Exit 0; exit 2 on invalid parameters.

scripts.name: Clean Windows and user temp files (Windows)
scripts.description: Removes files older than N days from C:\Windows\Temp and each profile Temp folder, reports bytes freed. Does not touch SoftwareDistribution. Dry run by default.

params.name: age_days
params.label: Minimum age in days
params.description: Only files last modified more than this many days ago are removed (1 to 365).

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When enabled, nothing is changed and the script only prints what it would do.

scripts.output: Per-location [DRY-RUN]/[DONE]/[SKIP] lines and a total of bytes freed. Exit 0; exit 2 on a bad parameter.

scripts.name: Start Microsoft Defender quick scan (Windows)
scripts.description: Starts a Defender quick scan and waits a limited time for it to finish. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When enabled, nothing is changed and the script only prints what it would do.

scripts.output: [DRY-RUN] or [DONE]/[SKIP] lines. Exit 0; exit 3 if Defender is not usable.

scripts.name: Microsoft Defender status (Windows)
scripts.description: Reports real-time protection, signature age and version, last scan times and tamper protection state.
scripts.output: Key/value Defender status lines. Exit 0; prints NOT AVAILABLE if Defender is absent.

scripts.name: Update Microsoft Defender signatures (Windows)
scripts.description: Asks Defender to update its antimalware signatures with Update-MpSignature. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When enabled, nothing is changed and the script only prints what it would do.

scripts.output: [DRY-RUN] or [DONE]/[SKIP] lines with signature version before and after. Exit 0; exit 1 if the update failed.

scripts.name: Physical disk health (Windows)
scripts.description: Reports physical disk health, operational status, media type and size, plus temperature, wear and read error counters when available.
scripts.output: Disk table and per-disk reliability counters; NOT AVAILABLE where cmdlets are missing. Exit 0.

scripts.name: .NET and Visual C++ runtimes (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists the installed .NET Framework version, .NET runtimes (if dotnet is installed) and Visual C++ redistributables.
scripts.output: Three sections: .NET Framework, .NET runtimes, Visual C++ redistributables. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Critical and error events (Windows)
scripts.description: Summarises Critical and Error events from the System and Application logs, grouped by source and event ID with the newest message.

params.name: hours
params.label: Hours to look back
params.description: How many hours of events to scan.

scripts.output: Top 40 groups with counts and truncated newest message. Exit 0; exit 2 on invalid parameters.

scripts.name: Windows Firewall status (Windows)
scripts.description: Shows each firewall profile with enabled state and default actions, plus counts of enabled rules.
scripts.output: Profile table and rule counts by direction and action. Exit 0; prints NOT AVAILABLE if the cmdlets are missing.

scripts.name: Flush DNS resolver cache (Windows)
scripts.description: Clears the Windows DNS client resolver cache. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When enabled, nothing is changed and the script only prints what it would do.

scripts.output: [DRY-RUN] or [DONE]/[SKIP] line. Exit 0; exit 3 if the cache could not be cleared.

scripts.name: Free space by volume (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists each fixed volume with size, free space and percent free.
scripts.output: Table of volumes with total, free and percent free. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Hosts file contents (Windows)
scripts.description: Prints the active entries of the hosts file with the entry count, SHA256 hash and last write time.
scripts.output: File metadata and the non-comment lines (up to 200). Exit 0.

scripts.name: Installed software list (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists installed programs from the 64-bit, 32-bit and loaded user uninstall registry keys, de-duplicated and sorted by name.

params.name: limit
params.label: Maximum rows
params.description: Maximum number of programs to list (10 to 1000).

scripts.output: Table of name, version, publisher. Exit 0; exit 2 on a bad limit.

scripts.name: Largest top-level folders (Windows)
scripts.description: Totals disk usage of each top-level folder under a root directory (one level deep) and lists the largest, within a time budget.

params.name: root_dir
params.label: Root directory
params.description: Absolute Windows path whose immediate sub-folders are measured.

params.name: top_n
params.label: Number of folders
params.description: How many folders to list (1 to 50).

scripts.output: Table of the largest sub-folders with sizes and a note if the time budget cut the scan short. Exit 0; exit 2 on an invalid parameter.

scripts.name: Recent interactive logons (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists recent interactive, RDP and cached logons from Security event 4624 and the last use time of each local profile. Reports clearly if the Security log is unreadable.

params.name: days
params.label: Days to look back
params.description: How many days of Security log to scan.

params.name: limit
params.label: Maximum events
params.description: Maximum number of logon events to list.

scripts.output: Logon table (time, account, type, source) followed by per-profile last use. Exit 0 always; exit 2 on invalid parameters.

scripts.name: Listening ports and owning processes (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists listening TCP ports and bound UDP endpoints with the process that owns each.
scripts.output: Tables of TCP listeners and UDP endpoints (first 200 each). Exit 0.

scripts.name: Local Administrators group members (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists the members of the local Administrators group with their source and object class. Report only.
scripts.output: Table of members with name, class and source. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Local user accounts (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists local accounts with enabled state, last logon, password last set and whether a password is required. No password data is shown.
scripts.output: Table of local accounts. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Network diagnostics to a target (Windows)
scripts.description: Runs ping, a traceroute (max 15 hops, no name lookups) and a DNS lookup against one validated host name or IP address.

params.name: target
params.label: Target host or IP
params.description: Host name or IP address to test.

params.name: count
params.label: Ping count
params.description: Number of ping packets (1 to 10).

scripts.output: Ping output, traceroute output and DNS answers. Exit 0; exit 2 on an invalid target or count.

scripts.name: Pending reboot reasons (Windows)
scripts.description: Reports each pending-reboot signal separately (CBS, Windows Update, file renames, rename, domain join, SCCM) and a final verdict.
scripts.output: One line per signal and a final REBOOT PENDING: yes/no line. Exit 0 always.

scripts.name: Pending Windows updates (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists updates not yet installed and not hidden, using the Windows Update Agent search. May take a few minutes.
scripts.output: List of pending updates with KB and size, or a note if the search failed or timed out. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Clear print queue (Windows)
scripts.description: Stops the Print Spooler, deletes only the *.SPL and *.SHD files in the spool PRINTERS folder, then starts the Spooler again. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) nothing is changed and the script only reports what it would do.

scripts.output: File count and bytes, then [DONE]/[SKIP] lines or a [DRY-RUN] line. Exit 0; 3 if the spooler is not running afterwards.

scripts.name: Restart Print Spooler (Windows)
scripts.description: Restarts the Print Spooler service and reports its state before and after. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) nothing is changed and the script only reports what it would do.

scripts.output: State before/after with [DONE]/[SKIP] lines, or a [DRY-RUN] line. Exit 0; 3 if the spooler is not running afterwards.

scripts.name: Remote Desktop status (Windows)
scripts.description: Reports whether RDP is enabled, whether NLA is required, the port, the Remote Desktop firewall rules and current sessions.
scripts.output: Lines for each RDP setting plus quser session output. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Restart if a reboot is pending (Windows)
scripts.description: Checks for a pending reboot and, if one is needed, schedules a restart after a delay with a visible message. Will not stack a second schedule. Dry run by default.

params.name: delay_minutes
params.label: Delay in minutes
params.description: Minutes before the restart happens (1 to 1440).

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When enabled, nothing is changed and the script only prints what it would do.

scripts.output: Reasons a reboot is pending and a [DRY-RUN]/[DONE]/[SKIP] line. Exit 0; exit 2 on a bad delay; exit 3 if scheduling failed.

scripts.name: Restart a named service (Windows)
scripts.description: Restarts one service by exact name after strict validation. Refuses the agent and critical system services. Dry run by default.

params.name: service_name
params.label: Service name
params.description: Exact service name (not display name), letters, digits and _ . @ : - only. No wildcards.

params.name: wait_seconds
params.label: Wait seconds
params.description: How long to wait for the service to stop and to start.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) nothing is changed and the script only reports what it would do.

scripts.output: State before and after plus [DONE]/[SKIP] lines, or [DRY-RUN] lines. Exit 0 on success, 2 invalid or refused name, 3 service not running afterwards.

scripts.name: Non-Microsoft scheduled tasks (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists scheduled tasks outside the Microsoft folders with state, run-as account, last result and last/next run times.

params.name: limit
params.label: Maximum tasks
params.description: Maximum number of tasks to list.

scripts.output: Table of tasks, marked (truncated) when the limit is hit. Exit 0; exit 2 on invalid parameters.

scripts.name: Stopped automatic services (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists services set to start automatically that are not running, excluding trigger-start services and known benign ones.
scripts.output: Count and table of stopped automatic services. Exit 0.

scripts.name: SMB1 status (Windows)
scripts.description: Checks the SMB1 server and client features and the SMB server configuration, and gives a plain-language verdict.
scripts.output: Feature and configuration lines followed by a Verdict line. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Startup items (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists Run and RunOnce registry entries (machine and loaded user hives), startup folders and Win32_StartupCommand entries.
scripts.output: Sections for registry, folders and WMI startup commands. Exit 0.

scripts.name: System information summary (Windows)
scripts.description: Prints OS and build, model, serial number, CPU, memory, domain or workgroup, IP addresses, last boot time and BIOS details.
scripts.output: Key/value summary lines. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Clean Microsoft Teams cache (Windows)
scripts.description: Clears classic Teams cache folders and the new Teams local cache for all user profiles. Skips everything if Teams is running and skip_running is true. Dry run by default.

params.name: skip_running
params.label: Skip if Teams is running
params.description: When true, nothing is cleaned while Teams is running.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) nothing is changed and the script only reports what it would do.

scripts.output: Per-folder [DONE]/[DRY-RUN]/[SKIP] lines and total bytes. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Force time resync (Windows)
scripts.description: Starts the Windows Time service if stopped and runs w32tm /resync /force, reporting offset before and after. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) nothing is changed and the script only reports what it would do.

scripts.output: Before/after offset with [DONE]/[SKIP] lines, or [DRY-RUN] lines. Exit 0; 3 if W32Time cannot be started.

scripts.name: Time synchronisation status (Windows)
scripts.description: Shows W32Time service state, time source, configuration, offset, last sync and the time zone.
scripts.output: Service, time zone, w32tm status and configuration lines. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Top processes by CPU and memory (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists the busiest processes by current CPU use and by working set memory.

params.name: top_n
params.label: Number of processes
params.description: How many processes to list in each ranking (1 to 50).

scripts.output: Two tables: top CPU and top memory. CPU is a one-moment sample summed across cores. Exit 0; exit 2 on a bad top_n.

scripts.name: Uptime and last boot time (Windows)
scripts.description: Shows the last boot time and how long the machine has been running, with a note when Fast Startup can make uptime look longer than it is.
scripts.output: Last boot time, uptime in days/hours/minutes and a Fast Startup note. Exit 0.

scripts.name: Reset Windows Update components (Windows)
scripts.description: Stops the update services, renames SoftwareDistribution and catroot2 to dated .bak folders, removes older .bak folders and restarts the services. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When enabled, nothing is changed and the script only prints what it would do.

scripts.output: [DRY-RUN] or [DONE]/[SKIP] lines per step. Exit 0; exit 3 if services could not be stopped. Services are restored even on failure.

scripts.name: Outdated packages (winget) (Windows)
scripts.description: Lists packages with available upgrades using winget. Only lists; nothing is installed or upgraded.
scripts.output: The winget upgrade table. Exit 0; prints NOT AVAILABLE if winget is not found.

check_sets.name: Workstation baseline (Windows)
check_sets.description: Disk, memory, sustained CPU, key services, pending reboot, clock, certificates, disk health, uptime and antivirus for Windows desktops and laptops.

params.name: ntp_server
params.label: Time server
params.description: Server the time check compares against. On a domain use a domain controller.

params.name: uptime_warn_days
params.label: Uptime warning (days)
params.description: Warn when the machine has not restarted for this many days.

params.name: uptime_fail_days
params.label: Uptime critical (days)
params.description: Critical when the machine has not restarted for this many days.

check_sets.name: Server baseline (Windows)
check_sets.description: The workstation checks with stricter disk limits, the server, time and scheduler services and an optional backup agent service.

params.name: ntp_server
params.label: Time server
params.description: Server the time check compares against. On a domain use a domain controller.

params.name: uptime_warn_days
params.label: Uptime warning (days)
params.description: Warn when the machine has not restarted for this many days.

params.name: uptime_fail_days
params.label: Uptime critical (days)
params.description: Critical when the machine has not restarted for this many days.

params.name: backup_service
params.label: Backup agent service
params.description: Name of your backup agent's service. Leave empty to skip the check.

check_sets.name: Server baseline (Linux)
check_sets.description: Disk and inode space, memory, swap, sustained CPU, failed systemd units, SSH, pending reboot, clock, certificates, disk health, uptime and an optional backup service.

params.name: ntp_server
params.label: Time server
params.description: Server the time check compares against. On a domain use a domain controller.

params.name: ssh_service
params.label: SSH service
params.description: systemd unit of the SSH server (ssh on some Debian releases).

params.name: cert_paths
params.label: Certificate files or folders
params.description: Absolute paths of certificates to watch (for example /etc/letsencrypt/live/example.org/fullchain.pem). Leave empty to skip the check.

params.name: uptime_warn_days
params.label: Uptime warning (days)
params.description: Warn when the machine has not restarted for this many days.

params.name: uptime_fail_days
params.label: Uptime critical (days)
params.description: Critical when the machine has not restarted for this many days.

params.name: backup_service
params.label: Backup agent service
params.description: Name of your backup agent's service. Leave empty to skip the check.

policies.name: Starter: Workstation baseline
policies.description: Draft. Baseline checks for Windows workstations. Review, then enable and assign it.

params.label: Time server
params.description: Server the time check compares against. On a domain use a domain controller.

params.name: uptime_warn_days
params.label: Uptime warning (days)
params.description: Warn when the machine has not restarted for this many days.

params.name: uptime_fail_days
params.label: Uptime critical (days)
params.description: Critical when the machine has not restarted for this many days.

policies.name: Starter: Windows Server baseline
policies.description: Draft. Baseline checks for Windows servers, with an optional backup agent service. Review, then enable and assign it.

params.name: ntp_server
params.label: Time server
params.description: Server the time check compares against. On a domain use a domain controller.

params.name: uptime_warn_days
params.label: Uptime warning (days)
params.description: Warn when the machine has not restarted for this many days.

params.name: uptime_fail_days
params.label: Uptime critical (days)
params.description: Critical when the machine has not restarted for this many days.

params.name: backup_service
params.label: Backup agent service
params.description: Name of your backup agent's service. Leave empty to skip the check.

policies.name: Starter: Linux Server baseline
policies.description: Draft. Baseline checks for Linux servers, with optional certificate and backup service checks. Review, then enable and assign it.

params.name: ntp_server
params.label: Time server
params.description: Server the time check compares against. On a domain use a domain controller.

params.name: ssh_service
params.label: SSH service
params.description: systemd unit of the SSH server (ssh on some Debian releases).

params.name: cert_paths
params.label: Certificate files or folders
params.description: Absolute paths of certificates to watch (for example /etc/letsencrypt/live/example.org/fullchain.pem). Leave empty to skip the check.

params.name: uptime_warn_days
params.label: Uptime warning (days)
params.description: Warn when the machine has not restarted for this many days.

params.name: uptime_fail_days
params.label: Uptime critical (days)
params.description: Critical when the machine has not restarted for this many days.

params.name: backup_service
params.label: Backup agent service
params.description: Name of your backup agent's service. Leave empty to skip the check.
